title: feat(spec)!: retire an agent's model.provider — no runtime read it; the deployment's AI settings choose the provider
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6xSMqJULJVMTrh5LMSQ4SD)_

Fixes #37712

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37796

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：agent 元数据里的 `model.provider`（openai / azure_openai / anthropic / local）从来没有运行时读取，按 ADR-0049「执行或移除」退役。供应商由部署的 AI 设置决定，agent 只写模型名。
- 影响：以后 agent 里写 `provider` 会报错，并提示删掉这一行；`os migrate meta --from 18 --write` 会自动删。18.x 默认写进去的 `provider: 'openai'` 会被静默剥掉，已构建、已存储的 agent 照常加载。元数据预览不再显示供应商标签。运行时行为不变。
- 要你做什么：无（座位已采纳退役路线，hold 记录 7206344767）。

## What changes

- **Schema** (`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`): `AIModelConfigSchema.provider` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone with the prescription, so writing it fails `tsc` (input type `never`) and the parse answers with the fix. The 18.x emitted default `provider: 'openai'` is accepted as inert residue and stripped (`acceptRetiredDefaultResidue`, the #12840 rule for a retired defaulted key; same shape as `ViewSharingSchema`). Every other value meets the tombstone.
- **ADR-0087 kit**: D2 conversion `agent-model-provider-removed` (`conversions/entries/19/`, step 19, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`, lossless `stripKeys`); `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[19]` entry `ai/AIModelConfig:provider`; D3 semantic entry `agent-model-provider-retired` (relevance `agents`); one sentence in the step-19 rationale; JOIN row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`.
- **Ledger**: `liveness/agent.json` `model` row note records the removal (a nested key has no row of its own). Evidence and `verifiedAt` unchanged: this session cannot read the cloud repository to re-verify it.
- **Generated**: `authorable-surface/ai.json` (`[RETIRED]` row), `content/docs/references/ai/agent.mdx`.
- **`DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[19]`** (from #37697): the reason no longer tells authors to write `provider: 'openai'`; it points at this retirement instead.
- **Form**: the agent form's `model` help text no longer names a provider; the 11 locale bundles were regenerated (`en`) and hand-trimmed (the other ten drop the provider word only).
- **UI** (`AgentPreview.tsx`): the preview shows the model name alone; a stale draft that still carries a provider never shows it.
- **Docs and fixtures**: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` (table row + 4 examples), `getting-started/common-patterns.mdx`, `packages/spec/docs/MCP_GUIDE.md`, `docs/notes/crm-development-standards.mdx`, `os explain agent` text and example, `benchmark.bench.ts`, `metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts`, `agent.test.ts`.
- **Pins**: `src/ai/agent-model-provider-retirement.test.ts`: refusal at every door (schema, `defineStack`), residue strip with a near-value control, `tsc` channel, D2 conversion on the stored-row seam and the boot door, idempotence, load-path retirement, registration, and a tree-scoped absence walk over the declared radius (added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`).
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/37712-agent-model-provider-retired.md`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO table, ADR-0087 marker.

## Why

ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. Removal, not enforcement, because:
1. The enum does not match the deployment's providers. The deployment's list is `AI_PROVIDERS` in `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai-models.ts` (`gateway`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `deepseek`, `dashscope`, `cloudflare`, `siliconflow`, `openrouter`). `azure_openai` and `local` are not providers a deployment has, and most real ones cannot be written. Enforcing it would mean redesigning the key, not adding a reader.
2. objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 phase 1 resolves a model by its id among the providers the deployment turned on. The capability "pin an agent to a model" is `model.model`, which is live.
3. No reader in this repository (only the preview pill). Cloud side: the ledger's cross-repo row (cloud @cb8ee7ff) and the card's 11-26 read of cloud main; not re-verified here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Decided in the thread (small things):** the residue stage is adopted. Every released 18.x toolchain wrote `provider: 'openai'` into each parsed `model` block, so refusing that value would refuse agents nobody wrote a provider for; the #12840 rule names this case. Cost: an explicit `provider: 'openai'` in untyped JSON is stripped silently (`tsc` still refuses it in TypeScript).
- **Overlap:** `overlap-check` against `origin/main` is clean. Against #37676 there is one conflict in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` (both insert a line at the head of the sorted `MAJOR_19_CONVERSIONS` list). It cannot be avoided by placement; whichever lands second keeps both lines sorted by identifier. The step-19 rationale sentence was placed so it does not conflict.
- **Out of scope:** the ledger says `model.topP` has no reader either. `top_p` is a mainstream setting, so the fix is a reader in cloud's AI runtime (`carrier: cloud`, raised with the seat).
- **Skills (follow-up #37796):** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:370` (`provider` table row) and `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json:17` (expected output names the enum). The tombstone keeps the identifier in `packages/`, so neither gate goes red on this PR; the skills card follows the retirement.

- **Absence walk radius:** the tree-scoped absence walk covers the five roots `spec#test` already declares and excludes `ui/`; the `ui/` agent fixtures were cleaned by hand (commit 8655944d13). They are untyped objects, so tsc did not catch them either.

## Verification

- ui fixtures: `automationPreviews.i18n-10862` and three more (`emptyCollection-8526`, `ResourceListPage.servedListColumns-36860`, `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts`) stop writing `provider` (commit 8655944d13); those 5 files 121 passed, console preview-samples 47 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated`: 14/14 up to date.
- Source audits: `check:empty-state`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:yaml-examples`, `check:template-manifests`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:error-code-provenance`, `check:duration-unit-keys`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:llms-txt`: all exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc + scripts + test-typecheck): 0.
- `@objectstack/spec` full vitest: 998 files, 30139 passed; the one failure on the first run (`retired-key-removal-version.pin` JOIN row) is fixed and that file re-run green.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: all bundles in sync. `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-changeset-no-major`: 0.
- `packages/cli` `test/commands.test.ts` + `test/explain-rule-id.test.ts`: 64 passed. `packages/objectql` `metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts`: passed. `ui` `AgentPreview*`: 24 passed.
- eslint on the new and changed source files: clean.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (changed files).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's standing exception).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
